source_facts.description: Our Beer > Peeper Peeper Pale Ale ABV 5.5% Year Round Available on tap & in bottles in our tasting room Maine Big Night is a community science project with eyes on responsible stewardship of the amphibian ecosystem. After a long winter of hiding beneath leaves, soil, and logs, many amphibians will re-emerge when night temperatures reach approximately 40°F and the ground is soaked in rain. Each year, hundreds of volunteers assemble across the state when the conditions are right, to ensure safe highway crossings for species like Spotted Salamanders and Spring Peepers. mainebignight.org Aromas of peach, orange, lemon, grapefruit, and melon. Notes of pine, raspberry, and strawberry. Underlying malt grain sweetness. Amarillo, Cascade, Centennial American 2-Row, Carapils, Red Wheat, Vienna In 2009, we opened shop on Industrial Way in Portland. We had a one barrel brew house. The term nano brewery was not even around yet, as far as I know. A brewery had not been started in Maine for a long time. Our plan was to do one beer really well to start. Make only beer that we want to drink, period. No market research. Do it, do it well. If they drink it, great. If they don’t, we go back to our day jobs. We worked on a single recipe. Over and over and over and over. Spring Peeper Ale (now Peeper) was born. I hit the streets with a small, cheap cooler filled with our beer. Door to door I went. Sometimes my young daughter, Zoe, would come along. 525 US Route 1 Freeport, Maine 04032 207.221.5711 Subscribe To Our Newsletter Thank You. © 2026 Maine Beer Company | Privacy Policy
